title: Product Sans / Glyph Set Continued
slide_intent: Document specialist forms so numerical and symbolic content can be composed with the same typographic care as ordinary words.
strategic_value: Purpose-built fractions, symbols and tabular figures can extend a consistent Google identity into less common content.
demonstration: A compact blue-on-white column lists numerator/denominator forms, fractions, symbols, Roman numerals, circled digits, case-sensitive forms and tabular lining figures.
practical_value: Choose the relevant numeral or symbol feature from the actual specimen instead of substituting an unrelated face prematurely.
